edge_configuration.PUBLIC_ORIGIN: one exact HTTPS app origin; previews refused
edge_configuration.BACKEND_ORIGIN: one fixed HTTPS backend origin; no path/query/userinfo
edge_configuration.TRUSTED_EDGE_INGRESS_SECRET: server-only provider secret, same independent 32..256-byte value as backend; overwrite browser header on every backend proxy; rotate/redeploy both sides; never in frontend/config.js
edge_configuration.ANALYTICS_SCRIPT_ORIGINS: space-separated exact approved analytics HTTPS origins
edge_configuration.LIVE_ORIGIN: optional exact HTTPS gthread streaming upstream in full only; absent => polling, never pin a sync web worker
edge_configuration.MEDIA_ORIGINS: space-separated exact signed media storage HTTPS origins
edge_configuration.PUBLIC_API_URL: optional explicit cross-site HTTPS URL ending /api; default /api, never /api/v1; add its exact origin to CONNECT_ORIGINS
edge_configuration.PUBLIC_TENANT_TOKEN: optional publishable tenant bootstrap token; not an account credential, exposed in config.js

backend_prerequisites: Validate exact upstream Host and independently authenticate trusted edge ingress before trusting X-Forwarded-Host/Proto/For
Use validated forwarded host for tenant/bootstrap/staff-origin and CSRF checks; never ALLOWED_HOSTS=*
Configure exact proxy count; bind direct self-host ingress privately
Secure host-only auth cookies, original Cookie/Origin/CSRF headers preserved; no Domain rewriting
Deny every internal/control path at public backend ingress; admit precisely the secret-authenticated free tick on its separate backend path
Disable/redact provider request logs containing bearer paths or signed queries; no cache rules overriding no-store

worker_free.secret: FREE_TICK_SECRET via wrangler secret put; same protected value as backend, never browser env
worker_free.rotation: replace backend and trigger secret, restart/redeploy, verify progress and old-secret refusal
worker_free.validation: Measure deployed CPU/request/cron/subrequest allowances; real scheduler, no always-awake guarantee

pages: node deploy/static/prepare.mjs pages <new-output-dir>; deploy staged output with Wrangler Pages; runtime env from edge_configuration; fail closed on function quota exhaustion
vercel: node deploy/static/prepare.mjs vercel <new-output-dir>; deploy staged root with Vercel CLI; exact production env, no preview authority; verify account plan permits use
netlify: Use deploy/static/netlify/netlify.same-origin.toml (copy over the root netlify.toml, which keeps the original split setup); exact runtime edge env via provider UI/API, never toml secrets
cross_site_alternative: Explicit HTTPS apiUrl; exact CORS/CSRF/staff/public origins, Secure cookies and supported SameSite; third-party cookie blocking may prevent unrelated provider-domain sessions
acceptance: Not certified by source/unit checks; run cloud-static.spec.ts for every host and real managed/free flows, uploads, auth, tenant boundaries, QR/WASM, polling/PWA, scheduled calls and CPU measurement before release
